posts.author: Ac3_Pilot
posts.body:
Hi all,
I've got the old urge to make a game again and I'm currently deciding on a battle system for my project: it's either going to be an action-rpg or a strategy rpg; currently leaning more toward the first, and to that end I'm testing the plugin in the title (on steam it's called "RPG Maker MZ - ARPG plug-in set" - and it's free) to see if could work for what I'm thinking about.
Alas, while I figured many things by myself, I could use some help to figure out some others.
For the sake of clarity:
1) I'm using the un-modified sample project included in the plugin dlc;
2) No other plugin has been added and therefore there should be no conflict with anything;
3) The sample game works correctly.
On to my questions:
1) Through the use of the included "CharacterImageEX" plugin it is possible to add a comment in any event to change their size. This works very well to change the size/shape of monster events on the map (comment scaleX and scaleY), but is there a way to apply this to the player character as well? It wouldn't do to have everything at a "normal" size and then the player as a small sprite.
2) Through the use of the included "MapActorStatus" plugin there is a small player status window in the lower right part of the screen: instead of having "HP" and "MP" in it I mean to change these to something else (for example instead of "HP" I might use "Health"): I know this can be done my changing the "terms" in the database but the words I plan to use are just a bit too big and end up conflicting with the numbers at the end of the bar; is there a way to reduce the font size of the wording there? I do not wish to make the bars longer.
3) Not so much a question but.. regardless of what I specify in the database (item type equipped by the player and system 2 settings) the game always default to using the second weapon animation of "weapon1" (the sword) > I changed that animation to something else and indeed it changed. My guess: something is forcing the "attack" skill to use specifically that file/animation instead of (as specified somewhere in the plugin/readme) use the "user defined" animation - thoughts? Less important/urgent than the other questions but makes me curious.
4) Am I wasting time here as maybe there is a better plugin to implement an action rpg in RPG Maker MZ?
Apologies for the wall of text - in my head this was meant to be a quick and simple thing.. - and thank you in advance for any help!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
1) no need - the main plugin use is for using the same sprite in different sizes for different events.
if you want to change a single sprite to a constant other size, you can do so in an image program - there is no fixed size requirement for sprites.
this tutorial might help you:
How to create your own templates (any sprite or battler sheet)
Time and time again people who want to create their own sprites are asking for pre-made empty/framed templates because they can't work without them. And they don't even understand how limiting that is.  Templates are crutches - bad crutches to be precise, because if you need a premade template...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
just resize the player sprites to whatever size you want.
3) there is a trait to change the attack skill that can be added to weapon or actor or so, just use that to switch to a skill with a different weapin type/animation
I think it's under "other traits", just look through all options until you find it.
4) depends on how you define "better". there are very few ABS-type plugins because they are a lot of work to write, but there are some - and each emphasizes of what the programmer considered important for the action.
unfortunately I don't use MZ myself so I can't tell you whaat alternatives exist.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Omar_RPG_1000 said:
one question, how can I make cross engine work in a ready made project, do you have a tutorial on that, and can I open the cross engine example project in mz?
Click to expand...
You can add it to an existing project by having the demo project and your project open at the same time and copy + pasting over the tool map and the database entries of what you want. You just have to update all the skill_id, item_id, etc references on the tool map to point to what database entries they are in your project. You also have to update any animations and images for the tools to your game's images.
I explain it at the end of my
guide here
